scenes.text: Quiz time! 6 tricky questions, from episodes 21 to 30. [1] Five seconds each. Count how many you get right. [2] Ready? Let's go!
Question 1. What does backpropagation do? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] It sends the error backward through the network, nudging each weight to reduce the mistake.

data.question: Backpropagation…
options: Sends the error backward to fix weights

scenes.text: Question 2. Grouping customers by behaviour, with no labels, is which type of learning? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] Unsupervised learning! No labels, the model finds the groups by itself.

data.question: Grouping customers, no labels. Which type?

scenes.text: Question 3. A model scores 99 percent on practice data, but 60 percent on new data. What's wrong? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] Overfitting! It memorised the practice data instead of learning general patterns.

Question 4. The cat sat on the mat because it was tired. In attention, which word does it focus on most? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] Cat! Mats don't get tired. Attention links it to the word that makes sense.
Question 5. What happens if the learning rate is way too high? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] It overshoots! The weights jump around too much, and training may never settle.
Question 6. In RLHF, what does the reward model learn from? [1] Five seconds. Keep score! <pause 4.5> [2] From humans picking the better of two answers. Those choices teach it what people prefer.

data.question: The RLHF reward model learns from…
